:::{#def-fold-out-rule}
#### Fold-out rule

For [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{j}$,
the **fold-out rule** $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$
is the [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule)
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $g$ produces
from the observations outside that fold:

$$
\fittedwo{j}{x} \eqdef g\paren{x; \paren{(x_i, y_i)}_{i \in I \setminus \fold{j}}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-out-rule}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who write the fitted function with the $k$th part of the data removed as $\hat f^{-k}$.
:::

:::
